svg.text: Position of the cup (well-shaped) and the cross term
Horizontal axis: center phase of the cup. The coin is fixed at 90° (red vertical dashed line). Well width 30°, depth h = 0.3194 R, harmonics 0–71.
Cross term at the coin center (90°) c(90°) = 2 f g
1. Cross-term waveform (local value; in units of R²)
C = ∫ c dψ (coin as on the previous day; no constant term)
Reference: C when the m = 0 term (a R / 2) is added to the coin
2. Cross term summed over the whole circle, C (in units of R²)
Without a constant term the coin sums to 0 over one turn, so an uncovered coin does not appear in C (it appears in the waveform).
